value.rationale: This gives an all-weight structural classification for an infinite family of naturally occurring nonassociative nonperfect algebras and a complete exact census in dimension three over all odd finite fields. The square-zero subcensus recovers whether the distinguished square generator is isotropic, a structural distinction hidden by the total operator count; the result complements rather than specializes the known maximal-nilindex classifications.
